description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to transactional state storage in Orleans, including the ITransactionalStateStorage interface, and classes for managing pending transactions, storage responses, metadata, and commit records.
external_methods: Task<string> Store(string, TransactionalStateMetaData, List<PendingTransactionState<TState>>, long?, long?)

classes.name: PendingTransactionState
classes.description: Represents a pending transaction with sequence ID, transaction ID, timestamp, transaction manager participant, and state.

classes.name: TransactionalStorageLoadResponse
classes.description: Encapsulates the response from loading transactional storage, including committed state, pending states, and metadata.

classes.name: TransactionalStateMetaData
classes.description: Stores metadata for transactional state, including timestamp and commit records.

classes.name: CommitRecord
classes.description: Represents a commit record with timestamp and list of write participants.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the transactional state from storage.

methods.name: Store
methods.description: Asynchronously stores transactional state, with options to commit or abort transactions.
